Bundled third-party source attribution

Primary package: lpilp/splsm2 2.0.1
Source: https://github.com/lpilp/simplesm2
Revision: d51b5b7eb5816b29561e9f4761dfe47221da5f96
Package license declaration: MIT (see LICENSE.txt).

Sm3.php, Sm4.php and SimpleSm4.php retain source headers crediting
lizhichao/sm (https://github.com/lizhichao/sm), distributed on Packagist
as lizhichao/one-sm. That project's composer.json declares Apache-2.0.
The Apache license text is included as LICENSE-APACHE-2.0.txt in addition
to the primary package's MIT notice. Original author and source headers
are retained in the delivered PHP files.

MPAY preserves the seven algorithm files byte-for-byte from the fixed
primary package. Their SHA-256 values are recorded in SOURCE.json.
MPAY's random-source and platform encoding adapter is outside this
third_party directory, in GuomiCrypto.php.
